common_definitions.gini: standard sorted nonnegative-vector Gini; NA for zero absolute mass
common_definitions.tie_break: ascending SHA-256(namespace + NUL + source_object_id + NUL + coordinate_id)
common_definitions.tie_permutation_seed: uint64_big_endian(first_8_bytes(SHA256('STAGE_Y_WITHIN_PATCH_TIE_V1_20260910' + NUL + source_object_id + NUL + decimal_block + NUL + decimal_patch + NUL + decimal_seed_index))) supplied to numpy.random.PCG64

within_patch.component: aggregate attention-branch signed 56x56 cell map for every block; no head/layer selection
descriptors: mean across 196 patches of population variance over 16 signed cell scores
mean normalized total variation on each 4x4 cell grid using horizontal/vertical absolute differences divided by absolute mass+1e-12
summed positive mass, negative mass and cancellation

primary_operator.native_patch_order: descending aggregate attention-branch positive mass; hash tie-break
primary_operator.nns_within_patch_order: descending positive signed 4x4-cell contribution; hash tie-break
primary_operator.control_within_patch_order: 32 fixed hash-seeded PCG64 permutations, seeds 0..31, independent per source_object_id/block/patch/seed
primary_operator.selected_count: round_half_up(percentile*3136/100), exact prefix of the hierarchical order
primary_operator.masking_baseline: normalized zero tensor equivalent to RGB [0.5,0.5,0.5]
primary_operator.auc: trapezoidal integral over fraction 0..1; higher deletion-loss AUC is better
primary_operator.image_block_gain: NNS AUC minus median of 32 control AUCs

metrics: top-1-percent absolute-mass share using ceil(0.01*3136)=32 cells
top-10-percent absolute-mass share using ceil(0.10*3136)=314 cells
absolute-mass-weighted source-patch RMS radius about its center of mass in patch-grid units
positive and negative center displacement from image center in normalized image-diagonal units

head_organization.input: 12 native head component arrays at the first residual addition

single_head_ablation.intervention_point: native per-head value-mixed output immediately before concatenation and output projection
single_head_ablation.replacement: all-zero tensor of identical dtype/shape before concatenation
single_head_ablation.effect: clean target logit minus ablated target logit, normalized by max(abs(clean target logit-baseline target logit),1e-6)
single_head_ablation.association: Spearman across all 12 heads between absolute allocation and normalized ablation loss; average across blocks after Fisher atanh(clipped rho,-0.999999,0.999999)
single_head_ablation.curve: simultaneous ablation of top-k and bottom-k heads for k=[1,2,3,4,6,8,10,12], ranked by absolute allocation with hash tie-break
single_head_ablation.failure: any missing head makes block association/curve FAILED, not a smaller-head complete case
single_head_ablation.restricted_causal_wording_gate: B2, B6 and B7 all SUPPORTED

metrics: destination entropy/effective destination count from column absolute masses
source concentration from row absolute masses
destination concentration from column absolute masses
matrix effective rank from normalized singular values as secondary
patch_mixing.raw_attention_role: descriptive association only; never NNS truth or claim gate

first_residual.confirmatory_share: attention absolute mass divided by identity plus attention absolute mass

second_residual.confirmatory_share: MLP absolute mass divided by residual plus MLP absolute mass

metrics: head absolute-share Spearman and cosine agreement
